statement: The existing home-lab test owner provides a sanctioned exact-commit certification verb: an operator can run one named classified test file or the canonical convergence-probes shard on an explicitly named ready lab machine at an explicitly named commit, repeat it a positive bounded number of times, and stop after the first red repetition. Every repetition reuses the existing machine-wide lab lock, thermal gate, classified runner, streamed verdicts, and result-ledger collection; changed/all/smoke/gate/postpush behavior remains unchanged, and --base-sha remains valid only for changed.

constraints.statement: Extend scripts/lab/lagrange-lab.js and scripts/lab/probe.js only: no raw SSH entry point, new remote execution mechanism, new loose script, workflow, or lifecycle src/ change.

The named-file and convergence-probes profiles refuse unless both --sha and --on are explicit; --sha resolves once to the exact full commit and --on is selected from the fleet discovered for that run.

The canonical convergence-probes shard is read through its existing path owner, test files are classified by the classified runner's plan, and every repetition traverses the existing lock, thermal, classified-runner, streaming, and result-copy path without retry or timeout widening.
Plain changed, smoke, gate, postpush, and all invocations preserve their existing commands; lane/split behavior remains limited to changed/all; --base-sha remains accepted only for changed.
Repeat is a positive bounded integer. A red repetition remains red; stop-on-first-red stops only later repetitions and never converts, retries, or hides the red result.
